n_trajectories_quote: In total, we have 25, 578 clip-level, 10, 304 phase-level, and 1, 076 video-level video-text pairs.

D1.reason: No time-stamped action variable chosen by an operator is recorded: clip texts are automatic speech-recognition transcripts (AWS/Whisper) of the lecture audio, i.e. model-derived narration, not human action labels or kinematics. No collection-mode statement. Not publicly released.

D2.reason: No outcome variable (success, skill, complication, error or independent sensor measurement) is documented.

D3.reason: Lecture videos are edited educational videos (steps can be 'edited out'), not continuous full recordings of a procedure; no video is released.

D4.quote: we query the videos based on keywords from three online platforms, i.e., Websurg (Websurg, 2023), EAES (EAES, 2023), and YouTube (YouTube, 2023).

D7.reason: Segment-level key-step texts come from the human-written lecture metadata and vary within a video, but the provenance of segment boundaries is not documented and nothing is public to inspect. Clip-level texts are ASR output (model-derived) and do not qualify.
